assertion: a relabel is reported as relabelled, not as add+remove

name: pro_browser_use_action_preflight
assertion: an identity the server never handed out is refused

name: pro_browser_use_browsers_select
assertion: a selection, or a blocker naming what is installed

name: pro_browser_use_browsers_launch_plan
assertion: a plan with an executable and a profile directory

name: pro_browser_use_browsers_attach_validate
assertion: loopback allowed, and the port is parsed out

assertion: status counts add up to 24 products × 30 capabilities

assertion: each capability answered with a reason

assertion: a live page opens and reports nodes

name: pro_browser_use_resize
assertion: page, capture and request agree on the new size

name: pro_browser_use_snapshot
assertion: a re-read advances the model and lists nodes

name: pro_browser_use_element_check
assertion: a live identity resolves as FRESH

name: pro_browser_use_coverage
assertion: the ledger states what it has not seen

name: pro_browser_use_outline
assertion: the outline is text, with its own truncation counts

name: pro_browser_use_screenshot
assertion: a capture reports a size with pixels behind it

name: pro_browser_use_extract
assertion: extraction answers, even when the honest answer is none

assertion: the reads are listed with their transition kinds
